enabled.description:
false: no update makes a snapshot (a snapshot you ask for with `lares-snapshot create` still works).

Takes true or false. Default: true.

minPackages.description:
A snapshot is made before an update that installs or upgrades at least this many packages (1 to 9999).

Takes a whole number 1 .. 9999. Default: 40.

criticalAlso.description:
Or that touches one of these packages, by name; `*` matches any text. This list replaces the built-in one (kernels, graphics driver, glibc, systemd, pacman and so on).
"critical": ["linux", "linux-lts", "nvidia*", "mesa", "glibc", "systemd", "pacman"],
Packages to add to the built-in list without replacing it.

Takes a list of texts. Default: [].

keep.description:
How many of the newest snapshots stay (1 to 50). A snapshot you mark as kept stays on top of these.

Takes a whole number 1 .. 50. Default: 5.

minFreeGB.description:
The update stops with nothing installed when a snapshot would leave less than this much free disk space, in GB (1 to 500).

Takes a number 1 .. 500. Default: 10.

maxAddedGB.description:
A snapshot that adds more than this many GB to the repository is stopped (1 to 500). The first snapshot is never limited this way.

Takes a number 1 .. 500. Default: 15.

maxMinutes.description:
A snapshot that takes longer than this many minutes is stopped (1 to 120). The first snapshot gets 60 minutes.

Takes a number 1 .. 120. Default: 15.

prime.description:
After an update, copy what it brought in the background (when the computer is idle), so the snapshot before the next update is short.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

exclude.description:
More folders to leave out, written in full. Only below /var/lib, /opt, /srv, /root and /usr/local, never /var/lib/pacman, no wildcards.

Takes a list of paths. Default: [].

onFail.description:
"stop": a snapshot that fails stops the update. "continue": the update goes on without it.

Takes "stop" or "continue". Default: "stop".

enabled.description:
Copy the snapshots to Proton Drive as well (lares-offsite).

Takes true or false. Default: false.

folder.description:
The folder on Proton Drive that holds the copies (it begins with /my-files/). Every machine has a folder of its own in it, and every repository one in that.

Takes a text like /my-files/Lares snapshots. Default: "/my-files/Lares snapshots".

machine.description:
This machine's folder; empty: the host's name.

Takes a text. Default: "".

onBattery.description:
Also copy while running on the battery.

Takes true or false. Default: false.

metered.description:
Also copy on a metered connection.

Takes true or false. Default: false.

everyHours.description:
A copy at most every this many hours (1 to 720), and one soon after an update that made a snapshot.

Takes a number 1 .. 720. Default: 24.

afterUpdate.description: Takes true or false. Default: true.
